page.overview:
Who is Alya Aldrete?

Lady Alya Aldrete was an Alderaanian female Human during the Imperial Era. Heiress to the business enterprise of the wealthy Aldrete family in the early years of the Galactic Empire, Alya achieved renown and celebrity status owing to her hedonistic lifestyle. Her public persona was however just a facade; Aldrete covertly established a smuggler fleet operating in the Core Worlds and Deep Core regions, using her criminal contacts to gather information and map reliable hyperlanes.

Circa 17 BBY, Aldrete attended the launch event on the world of Alderaan for her family's new luxury hovertrain. The train fell under attack from Trandoshan mercenaries and Aldrete was briefly captured, before being rescued by agents of Bail Organa, Alderaan's delegate to the Imperial Senate. Aldrete subsequently pledged her support to Organa's Alderaanian Resistance rebel group and marshalled her smuggler armada for a raid by the rebels against a prototype Super Star Destroyer under construction by the Empire in the Beshqek system. Aldrete and her forces successfully destroyed the leviathan warship, achieving one of the first victories of an insurgent group against the Imperial regime.

Lady Alya Aldrete was a wealthy Alderaanian female Human noblewoman of the affluent Aldrete family who lived during the early years of the Imperial Period. The heiress to her family's chain of casinos, hotels and passenger liners, Aldrete rose to prominence within galactic society as a result of her excessive pleasure-seeking and debauchery. She became a celebrity icon and her activities were widely reported in the media, including details of her romantic partners, her vacations and where she went clubbing.

In truth, Aldrete's public persona was just a carefully-cultivated cover. She also employed the elderly Twi'lek male Notru'denn as her personal assistant.
